summary: @eforms/forms-api runs install-time beacon exfiltrating host identity and CI env vars to oastify.com
details: The package has no functional code — index.js exports only {__researchCanary: true} — and all four npm lifecycle scripts (preinstall, install, postinstall, prepare) execute beacon.js. beacon.js collects os.hostname(), os.userInfo(), process.cwd(), platform/arch/Node version, and selected CI-related environment variables, base64-encodes the payload, and transmits it both via dns.lookup() against subdomain labels and via an HTTPS GET to a hardcoded Burp Collaborator subdomain at 2z237udr1jxdaiw54xzmzfb7nytohszuplipn34fm4.oastify.com. The scoped name @eforms/forms-api combined with the absence of any advertised functionality is consistent with a dependency-confusion probe against an internal @eforms namespace: on `npm install`, the installer's host identity, user, working directory, and CI environment identifiers are disclosed to whoever controls the oastify collaborator subdomain. The __researchCanary self-label does not change the behavior — the destination is a third-party out-of-band interaction host, not an endpoint the installer configured.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
